title: Nvidia’s first RTX Spark laptops cost up to $7,000. Here’s what you get
key_facts: RTX Spark is an Arm-based Nvidia chip now going into consumer Windows laptops, headlined by the Surface Laptop Ultra.
RTX Spark laptops start at $2,600; Surface Laptop Ultra runs from $2,600 to $5,900 fully loaded, $3,000 at the recommended configuration.
The integrated GPU matches an RTX 5070 'at least on paper'.
Models are listed from Microsoft, Asus, Dell, HP and Lenovo; MSI has also announced one.
Pre-orders should arrive on 16 Oct, or slightly later.
Dell's model has missing or inconsistent specifications; HP's OmniBook X 14 is not ready for the October launch.
quote_evidence: RTX Spark laptops start at $2,600 USD, and only get more expensive.
Pre-orders are available now, and shipments should be arriving next week.
Pre-orders should arrive on October 16th, or slightly later, depending on the usual factors.
why_it_matters_hint: First prices and ship date for Nvidia's Arm laptop platform; premium pricing.
event_date: 8 Oct 2026 (pre-orders); chip unveiled earlier in the week of 5 Oct 2026
